headline: Book hidden in fireplace returned to Australian library 150 years overdue
summary: A book hidden in a fireplace has been returned to an Australian library after roughly 150 years, possibly from a stonemason's collection.
script: A book hidden inside a fireplace has finally returned to an Australian library, one hundred fifty years overdue. It may have been borrowed by a stonemason who worked on London's Houses of Parliament.
imageAlt: A historic book found hidden inside a fireplace and returned to a library.
